message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard displays two conflicting encodings of feedback share. The vertical axis ('Value') positions the 'Other' marker lowest (approx. 22), which would route 'Other'. However, the explicit percentage labels printed above each marker indicate 'Service Design' has the lowest share at 12%. In data visualization, explicit data labels are the authoritative source for the specific value of a data point, whereas the vertical position here appears inconsistent with the labeled values (e.g., Service Quality is 52% but plotted near 60). Therefore, the lowest-share category is Service Design.", "option_label": "Route Service Design to low-feedback coverage follow-up"}
